item.title: Happy Thanksgiving from Interactive Powers
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Happy Thanksgiving from Interactive Powers This Thanksgiving, we want to thank those who make our work possible. Every day, from video kiosks and tablets in branches, hotels and clinics, our platform connects people with the right expert, wherever that expert is. Our customers, in banking, insurance, healthcare and the public sector, for trusting us with conversations where security and quality are essential. Our partners in Latin America, Europe and the United States, for taking our solutions to new markets and sectors.
